absorptionBoosters: Vitamin C-rich foods with the meal (lemon, amla, guava, tomato, capsicum)
Meat, fish or poultry at the same meal

Cooking acidic foods in iron cookware (small effect)
absorptionBlockers: Calcium (milk, curd, calcium tablets) taken with iron

logPresets.label: Low-dose iron supplement, 30 mg elemental (WHO lower daily dose)
Government IFA tablet, 60 mg elemental iron + 500 µg folic acid (prescription dose)
Ferrous sulfate 325 mg tablet, about 65 mg elemental (prescription dose)
Ferrous fumarate 200 mg tablet, about 66 mg elemental (calc.) (prescription dose)
Doctor-prescribed 120 mg elemental iron/day for anaemia in pregnancy (WHO) (prescription dose)

warnings: Iron tablets are a leading cause of poisoning in small children (secondary): keep out of reach; call a doctor or poison centre at once after any swallowing.
Do not start iron tablets without a blood test: thalassaemia trait, haemochromatosis and iron overload make extra iron harmful.
Iron over 45 mg/day from food and supplements is above the upper limit; only a doctor should set higher doses (prescription dose).
ICMR iron values are from snippets and are marked secondary, unverified; ICMR lactation and age 60+ values Not found.
Do not use IFCT spleen (53.1 mg/100 g) or turmeric (46.1 mg/100 g) as everyday iron sources; the IFCT 'Prawns, big' S008 row is flagged for sodium.

Users with chronic kidney disease, pregnancy, breastfeeding, haemochromatosis, thalassaemia or on levothyroxine, tetracyclines or quinolones: show 'Follow your doctor's advice' and do not set iron doses.
Black stools with weakness, or very heavy periods: see a doctor.

conditionAdjustments.change: Treatment dose is set by the doctor, often above the upper limit; alternate-day dosing studied; app does not set dose; requires doctor input

conditionAdjustments.change: Anaemia in CKD is managed by the kidney doctor: oral iron trial 1-3 months in non-dialysis CKD (KDIGO 2012), IV iron favoured in haemodialysis (KDIGO 2026); requires doctor input
conditionAdjustments.source: KDIGO 2012 and 2026 anaemia guidelines (via review snippets)

conditionAdjustments.change: RDA 27 mg/day; WHO 30-60 mg elemental iron daily with 400 µg folic acid; India programme 60 mg iron + 500 µg folic acid daily from 4th month; requires doctor input
